Initial release of the deps-mgmt skill providing a structured workflow for deep dependency management.

- Introduces a six-stage process covering inventory, policy, reproducibility, upgrades, security, and governance.
- Includes clear trigger conditions to identify when to apply the workflow.
- Offers defined goals and exit conditions for each workflow stage.
- Provides a comprehensive final review checklist to ensure best practices.
- Shares tips for effective dependency management and strategies for handling monorepo deviations.
